authority: Separate bounded local K4 development diagnostic; no resumption of the stopped raw pipeline, new raw scores, or paid work.
status: CLI available; not released. Physical FIT only, never development or the dedicated probe-calibration parents.
release: packing-release.json stage=packing-only-fit plus checksummed lineage, spatial control with explicit true gate, fit bank, eligibility, and roster. Require separate parent release digest; fail closed.
model_interface: packing-model-{512,2048}.joblib: spatial_raw.load(exact_file), spatial_raw.packing_offsets(model,shell,stratum); packing-oof-{512,2048}.npz: parent,anchor ordinal,stratum,stratum_oof,packing_oof in bank eligible row-major order. No raw predict interface for these artifacts.
timing_caveat: Linear-row planning extrapolation from the actual single control. Iterations, cache and tree costs can differ. Threefold allowance is not a guaranteed worst case. No inference, label-free or decoding time included.

synthetic_paired_decomposition.note: The packing baseline scored 0.009980 nat worse than stratum; the fitted residual recovered a point-estimate 0.003342 nat (33.48%) of that deficit, leaving raw 0.006639 nat worse than stratum. These are linear differences on the identical held rows, not a causal attribution. The interval for raw minus packing straddles zero. Since the raw fit used packing as its offset, these facts do not isolate optimization, finite-sample calibration variance, or representational limits. No evidence here says physical packing or raw will lose. No plant rescore.
